An unpaired eigenvalue is therefore +1 or -1, on which U+U*=XZ+ZX has eigenvalue +2 or -2. Hence the operator-norm anticommutation defect is at least 2, and the bound is sharp. Odd dimension cannot even approximate an involutive Clifford pair below this fixed error.
